manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Detention Sphere to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Detention Sphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Glorious Protector.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Detention Sphere and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Detention Sphere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Glorious Protector to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
